page_title: LIV 2-1 WHU | Liverpool v West Ham 13/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+8' Andy Madley is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) sends a long ball in, but Alisson comfortably gathers the ball.
90+6' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) earns the yellow card.
90+5' A player from West Ham pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
90+4' What a chance that is! Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
90+2' The free kick from long range, taken by West Ham, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
90+2' The referee blows his whistle as Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) will take a corner kick.

89' A snap shot by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Alphonse Areola produces a good save to thwart him. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
89' 2 - 1 Gooal! Alexis Mac Allister takes over corner duties. Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the bottom right corner. 2:1.

88' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Liverpool force their opponents to concede a corner.
86' West Ham take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
86' 1 - 1 It's an own goal! Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) scores into his own net!
85' A clumsy foul by Wataru Endo (Liverpool) and Andy Madley blows his whistle. It's a free kick to West Ham, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
85' Arne Slot decides to make a substitution. Mohamed Salah will be replaced by Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
84' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
83' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
82' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. West Ham are awarded a free kick.
81' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) sends a long ball in, but Alisson comfortably gathers the ball.
78' Graham Potter prepares a substitution. Carlos Soler is replaced by Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham).
78' It's time for a substitution. Luis Guilherme (West Ham) comes on in place of Jean-Clair Todibo.
78' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
77' Poor challenge! Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) is penalised for tripping and Andy Madley blows his whistle.
76' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
75' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
73' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.

72' A sweet pass finds Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Alisson is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
70' The corner is swung in but West Ham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
68' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) replaces Curtis Jones.
68' The substitution has been made. Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) has replaced Conor Bradley.

67' Great touch by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save! The referee points to the corner flag and West Ham will take a corner.
66' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
66' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham). Andy Madley saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Liverpool.
66' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
65' One of the West Ham players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Liverpool.
62' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
61' Carlos Soler (West Ham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for West Ham.
60' Substitution. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) in, Diogo Jota out.
60' Arne Slot has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) replacing Konstantinos Tsimikas.
59' A raking crossfield pass from Luis Diaz (Liverpool) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oliver Scarles trots off the pitch and is replaced by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham).
56' West Ham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
55' The resulting corner from Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is cleared by the defence.

54' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the top of the net, but Alphonse Areola is well positioned to make a comfortable save. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.
54' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner but it's cleared.
54' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Liverpool will take a corner kick.
53' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
52' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
51' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
51' West Ham quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
50' Andy Madley blows his whistle after Curtis Jones (Liverpool) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. West Ham earn a free kick.
49' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post.
48' A dangerous looking corner kick from Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) is cleared to safety by the defence.
47' Liverpool couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Alphonse Areola (West Ham) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
46' Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Andy Madley signals.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar.
45+1' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
45' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
44' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Diogo Jota (Liverpool) heads on.
43' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
43' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
41' Liverpool control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
39' Flag goes up against Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
38' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
37' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
35' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
34' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! He sent the ball into the stands. What a miserable header!

33' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Alphonse Areola, who tips the ball around the post.
32' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) is adjudged offside.
31' Andy Madley blows his whistle and signals a foul after Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) brought his opponent down. That's a free kick to West Ham.
29' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
23' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
22' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) shows his willingness to get forward and blasts a shot towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the shot isn't precise enough and hits the crossbar!
20' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is flagged for offside.
18' 1 - 0 Mohamed Salah does all the hard work to set it up on a plate for Luis Diaz (Liverpool), who needs no second invitation to bury the ball into the empty net. 1:0.
18' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.

16' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) has a great opportunity but fails to score. The ball from the corner falls to him and he unleashes a shot goalwards, but the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny him.
15' Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.
15' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) gathers a nice lofted pass just outside the box and attempts to put the ball inside the left post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
13' Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) was too forceful with his tackle and Andy Madley interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
10' Flag up against Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
9' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

9' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches over the crossbar.
6' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Alphonse Areola is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
4' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
3' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal. A cross into the box from Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is cleared.
2' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! West Ham will take the kick-off.
Andy Madley got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
